Who we are

VECTOR TECH is a technology and development brand founded by CHAD FDEV, built around a simple idea: every project has a direction and a destination, and good software is what gets it there.

We design and build websites, applications and digital tools for people and businesses who want their ideas turned into something real, usable and well made — without unnecessary complexity.

VECTOR TECH is still a growing brand. This site itself is our first shipped project, and it grows as our portfolio does — openly, one working release at a time.

Our approach

We favor clarity over clutter: clean code, honest timelines, and interfaces that are easy to use on the first try. Every project starts from what the end user actually needs, not from what looks impressive in a screenshot.

CF
CHAD FDEV Founder & Developer, VECTOR TECH

Our mission

To build reliable, well-crafted digital tools — websites and applications — that genuinely solve the problem they were built for.

Our vision

To grow VECTOR TECH into a small studio known for dependable delivery, thoughtful design, and technology that stays out of the user's way.

How we work

Every build is scoped clearly up front, developed in the open, and labelled honestly — live, in development, or planned.

Technologies we use

The core tools behind VECTOR TECH projects, in plain language.

Core stack

H5

HTML5

Provides the structure of a website — headings, sections, forms and content.

<section>
  <h1>Hello, world</h1>
</section>
C3

CSS3

Controls how a site looks — colors, layout, spacing and animation.

.card {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1rem;
}
JS

JavaScript

Makes websites interactive and dynamic in the browser.

btn.addEventListener(
  'click',
  () => alert('Hi!')
);
TS

TypeScript

Adds types to JavaScript, catching mistakes early and easing maintenance.

function add(a: number, b: number): number {
  return a + b;
}

Frameworks & tools we build with

⚛

React

Helps us build interactive interfaces out of reusable components.

function Hello({ name }) {
  return <h1>Hi, {name}</h1>;
}
JS

Node.js

Runs JavaScript outside the browser — useful for servers and back-end tools.

const http = require('http');
http.createServer((req, res) => {
  res.end('Hello!');
}).listen(3000);
PY

Python

A flexible language we use for scripting, automation and security tooling.

def greet(name):
    return f"Hello, {name}!"
git

Git

Tracks every change made to a project's code over time.

git add .
git commit -m "Initial commit"
git push origin main
gh

GitHub

Stores our code and makes it easy to collaborate and back up.

git clone \
  https://github.com/vic-tech7/ETHACKING.git

Privacy Policy

This document is provided in English only.

This is a general template and does not constitute legal advice. Please have it reviewed by a qualified lawyer to confirm it fully meets your GDPR obligations as a business based in Spain/the EU.

1. Who is responsible for your data

VECTOR TECH (CHAD FDEV), based in Spain, is the data controller for any personal data processed in connection with this site.

2. What this site does with your data

This site's contact form does not send data to a server — it opens your own email app with your message pre-filled, so you choose whether to send it. VECTOR TECH only receives what you actually send us, by email or WhatsApp.

3. What we store

The only thing this site stores automatically is your chosen display language, saved in your browser's local storage so the site remembers it next time. It stays on your device and is never sent to us.

4. Cookies and tracking

This site does not use cookies, analytics, or advertising trackers.

5. Third-party services

Page fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which may log basic request data (like your IP address) under Google's own privacy policy. The background music and images on this site are embedded directly and load no external services.

6. If you contact us

Any name, email address, or message content you choose to send us (by email, the contact form, or WhatsApp) is used only to respond to you, and isn't sold or shared with third parties.

7. Your rights

Because VECTOR TECH is based in Spain, the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) applies. You have the right to access, correct, or delete any personal data we hold about you, to restrict or object to how it's used, and to receive a copy of it. To exercise any of these rights, email vectordevtech@gmail.com. If you believe we haven't handled your data properly, you can also lodge a complaint with Spain's data protection authority, the Agencia Española de Protección de Datos (AEPD).

8. Children's privacy

This site isn't directed at children and we don't knowingly collect information from them.

9. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy as the studio grows. The version on this page is always the current one.

10. Contact

Questions about this policy? Email vectordevtech@gmail.com.
